name: comp-459

frames.best_why: Shows the whole pager with page 3 marked and the ellipsis, clear of the cursor.

tagline: Numbered page links with a dotted gap and Previous and Next ends.
summary: A single-row pager showing Previous and Next around pages 1 to 4, a three-dot ellipsis before the end, and the current page lifted onto a rounded block.
appearance: One flat row on black holds an arrow-led Previous, the numbers 1 to 4, a three-dot ellipsis and Next with a right arrow. Page 3 sits in a small rounded grey square, and hovered labels gain a darker rounded fill.
behaviour: Hovering any label lays a rounded block behind it; clicking a number moves the active square while the ellipsis stands for the skipped range. Nothing animates beyond the hover fills.
demo_content: Page numbers 1 to 4 with an ellipsis, and the Previous and Next labels.
search_phrases: page numbers with dots in between
go to page one two three
current page highlighted in a box
use_when: Paging a list where people need to jump to a nearby numbered page.
avoid_when: When the total is huge: the row still shows about five slots and relies on ellipses.
customise: Pass currentPage and totalPages, plus how many page slots to show; colours and the active box come from the shared pagination classes.
weight_why: A short row of page links; only hover fills and an active block.

a11y.note: Links have clear names and the ellipsis is described for screen readers; hover fills have no reduced-motion handling.

polish_why: Clear page row with a tidy active block, but a standard numbered pager.
title: Pagination With Ellipsis
